profile.geoLocationName: Surry Hills, New South Wales, Australia
profile.summary:
Josh has a passion of technology and is often found tinkering with systems and software looking for ways to make things easier and more efficient both in his personal and professional life.

He has completed a Bachelor of Information Technology at QUT focusing on software, mobile and web development and has experience working with a plethora of modern languages and environments including C# & Java languages and Windows, OSX and Linux based environments.

Always looking to further his professional development, Josh is currently looking at undertaking a Masters in Business (International Business)

Josh has previously worked in various positions within the Legal Services and Retail industries.

honors.title: ISBU Team Member of the Year FY08/09
honors.description:
From: Julie-Ann Crossley
Sent: Friday, 10 July 2009 7:27 AM
To: ISBU Helpdesk; GIS Sales
Cc: Mandi Kaplan; Cameron Beavis
Subject: ISBU NCCC Member of the Year Award goes to ...

This years winner is Josh!

Josh has really grown in the last 12 months and has stood up and gone above and beyond many many times, I am truly impressed with the maturity of Josh for someone so young, as well as his total commitment to the team, his area, the company, operational efficiencies and Qld I Cert – it has certainly contributed significantly to the growth of the company and the team.

Just a small sample of things that Josh has achieved this year to become the NCCC member of the year 

	0 sick days
	Has personally worked on operational efficiencies that we have all benefited from in his own time and in many cases without needing to be asked – just saw an opportunity and did it off his own back
	Has personally ensured the success of Qld I Cert by putting in many many hours of his own time to ensure everything gets done, processed on time and works as well as it can for customers
	Works well with all GI team members in a proactive manner to achieve good results
	Has worked many many hours overtime and gone truly above and beyond many times without ever asking for anything in return, whinging about it, self promoting for doing it etc
	I believe he has helped everyone on the floor at some point in time 
	Takes on things to learn and grow at a personal level
	Takes on constructive criticism well and learns and betters things from it

I am sure there are many more qualities Josh displays that have not been included here, but these are the main things.

Josh:  Job well done and thank you for your heart and passion, keep it up.

jac

projects.title: Rove and Rave project
projects.description:
Rove and Rave (RnR) is a project facilitated by QUT and the Endeavour Foundation to assist people with disabilities to achieve a higher level of independence within the community. Rove and Rave focuses heavily on complying with W3C's Web Accessibility Initiative (WAI) guidelines to ensure users of all abilities receive an immersive and fulfilling experience when using the RnR site.

The RnR website is developed using PHP (Zend Framework) as well as heavily utilising HTML5, CSS3 and other web technologies such as javascript. My involvement included development of new features as well as updating or optimising existing functionality, data collection to populate the site using scraping tools or manual collection, and site testing.

projects.title: IT Platform Upgrade Project
projects.description:
Formulate a new IT platform focusing on High Availability and Virtualisation to support new platforms implemented within the Fergies Facility. This project involves consultation with external vendors (hardware and software) and internal stakeholders. 

This project consists of:
- Relocation and consolidation of existing physical hardware to a new controlled environment, including networking equipment
- Implementation of a new virtual platform in a high availability arrangement with offsite disaster recovery
- Migration of existing physical servers to new virtual environment
- Migration of existing virtual environment to new virtual environment
- Modernisation of Server environments to newer versions
- Preparation of platform for new information systems
